entries.text: Fenwick Press registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Fenwick Atlas Edition: a case-bound volume of regional maps. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.
Expired product terms. Billing model: this edition was sold through a recurring annual subscription with automatic renewal.
Current product terms. Intended use: reference cartography study in a library setting. Billing model: a one-time purchase with no subscription and no automatic renewal.
